title: Private 1-Hour Las Vegas Strip Tour by Vintage Sidecar
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
An essence of the best of Las Vegas.
Your Gentlemen Sider will accompany you for a ride on a Sidecar to discover the corners and essential of the world-famous strip of Las Vegas. Be amazed by the contemporary architecture, lights and wide variety of attractions along the ride on the All-American Roads. This visit will be aboard an unexpected vehicle for 2 passengers, 1 comfy in the sidecar 1 funny behind the pilot (possibility to switch).
